prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 40 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1288; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. Over the course of 40 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, anti-inflammatory medication, activity modification, and a home exercise program, consistent with a typical course of conservative management for this type of injury. The mechanism described is a plausible cause of the knee complaints reported. Examination findings included localized tenderness and mild effusion that support the reported injury, while ligamentous stability testing and neurovascular assessment were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving this knee has been identified in the available history. Treatment frequency tapered as the patient's pain and mobility improved, and the patient was discharged to independent home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur. Billing records reflect services rendered as documented, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified.
